_comment: SMART-TRUST, declared as an INSTANTIATED harness, for the same reason and in the same change as `who-iris.config.json`. This repository holds smart-trust's artefact index, generates its 20 pages from it (`smart-trust:pages`, gated by `smart-trust:pages:check`), and as of bean `jut3` composes them through the just-the-docs pipeline into `_docs/smart-trust/`. A repo that generates, gates and publishes an instance's pages is instantiating it, whatever the absence of this file previously said.
_contentType_comment: `document`. The IG artefact index and its pages are structured prose and data; there is no Lean and no TeX here either.
